description: A single-panel 3-D contour/pseudo-colour plot whose only printed text heading is "Pass 3" in large black type. Two thin rectangular slab (parallelepiped) volumes are drawn side by side in oblique 3-D projection, with a small orthogonal coordinate triad at bottom centre — a red arrow labelled X, a green arrow labelled Y and a blue arrow labelled Z. The field is rendered as discrete colour bands with no colour bar, no legend, no axis tick values and no numeric labels anywhere in the panel. The right-hand slab shows a broad bright-green interior enclosed by a cyan and dark-blue rim, i.e. a pronounced core-to-surface gradient; the left-hand slab is dominated by dark blue with a few lighter blue and small cyan patches, so its interior levels are lower/different from the right slab's core. Because no colour scale is printed, the mapped variable (equivalent strain, stress or similar) and its numeric range cannot be established from the pixels. The heading "Pass 3" links the panel to the third multiaxial-forging pass of the Fe-30Mn-9Al-0.8 C low-density steel study.

subfigures.description: Pseudo-colour 3-D field plot headed "Pass 3": two thin rectangular slabs in oblique projection, coloured in banded contours (right slab with a green core and blue/cyan rim; left slab mostly dark blue), with an X (red), Y (green), Z (blue) coordinate triad at the bottom. No colour bar, legend, axis ticks or numeric labels are present, so the plotted quantity and its range are unknown.

observations.observation: The panel carries the printed heading "Pass 3" in large black text above the two slab volumes.
Two thin rectangular slab/parallelepiped volumes are rendered side by side in oblique 3-D projection.
A small orthogonal coordinate triad labelled X (red arrow), Y (green arrow) and Z (blue arrow) is drawn at the bottom centre of the panel.
No colour bar, legend, axis ticks, axis labels or numeric values are printed anywhere in the panel, so the mapped field variable and its range cannot be read from the image.
The right-hand slab displays a broad bright-green interior surrounded by a cyan and dark-blue rim, indicating a core-to-surface gradient of the mapped quantity.
The left-hand slab is predominantly dark blue with a few lighter blue and small cyan patches, i.e. it shows lower (different) field levels than the green core of the right-hand slab.
The field is displayed as discrete banded contour levels rather than a smooth continuous colour gradient.
The supplied caption consists only of the panel tag "(a)" and gives no description of what the colour field represents.

The study context states the material is Fe-30Mn-9Al-0.8 C low-density steel processed by warm multiaxial forging, with samples at 0, 1, 3 and 5 passes, which is consistent with the "Pass 3" heading but is not confirmed by any annotation inside the image.
The image contains no scale bar, so the physical size of the two slabs is indeterminate.
